assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of PSV-4111

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-4111 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-4111 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. PSV-4111 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 4 November 2011 a hazard report was recorded on PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
